g.text: U10 78L05: +5VA for the PGA2310 logic, U8 side 2 and the plug-sense pull-ups, about 15 mA.

g.desc: U10 78L05: +5VA for the PGA2310 logic, U8 side 2 and the plug-sense pull-ups, about 15 mA.

g.text: On the audio ground, so the 5 V logic never references USB. Input up to +14 V, 0.15 W in the TO-92.

g.desc: On the audio ground, so the 5 V logic never references USB. Input up to +14 V, 0.15 W in the TO-92.

g.text: Flags (unlabelled) mark +5V, +12V, -12V and GND_USB as driven for ERC, since they sit behind FB1 / L1 / L2 or the XIAO.

g.desc: Flags (unlabelled) mark +5V, +12V, -12V and GND_USB as driven for ERC, since they sit behind FB1 / L1 / L2 or the XIAO.

g.text: Ground barrier. GND_USB (XIAO, USB-C shell, U8 side 1, PS1 input) and GND (everything audio, U8 side 2,

g.desc: Ground barrier. GND_USB (XIAO, USB-C shell, U8 side 1, PS1 input) and GND (everything audio, U8 side 2,

g.text: PS1 output) meet only here: C45 gives the converter's switching noise a local return so it does not

g.desc: PS1 output) meet only here: C45 gives the converter's switching noise a local return so it does not

g.text: radiate as common mode, R17 stops the audio side floating away when nothing is plugged in.

g.desc: radiate as common mode, R17 stops the audio side floating away when nothing is plugged in.

g.text: Place both at PS1, on the 2 mm gap in the ground pours. No other copper crosses the gap.

g.desc: Place both at PS1, on the 2 mm gap in the ground pours. No other copper crosses the gap.

g.text: No external power supply. Everything runs from the USB 5 V that the XIAO passes out on its 5V pin (sheet 4).

g.desc: No external power supply. Everything runs from the USB 5 V that the XIAO passes out on its 5V pin (sheet 4).

g.text: PS1 is a board-mounted isolated 2 W DC-DC module: 5 V in, +/-12 V 80 mA out. Unregulated: the rails follow USB voltage and load,

g.desc: PS1 is a board-mounted isolated 2 W DC-DC module: 5 V in, +/-12 V 80 mA out. Unregulated: the rails follow USB voltage and load,

g.text: about +/-11 V on a sagging port and up to +/-14 V at 5.25 V and light load; every part on the rails is rated for that (PGA2310 max 16 V).

g.desc: about +/-11 V on a sagging port and up to +/-14 V at 5.25 V and light load; every part on the rails is rated for that (PGA2310 max 16 V).

g.text: Rails: +12 V ~55 mA (analog ~40 mA plus U10 ~15 mA), -12 V ~40 mA; the TBA 2 gives 80 mA per rail. Budget at 5 V: XIAO ~30 mA, PS1 ~230 mA, LED 2 mA;

g.desc: Rails: +12 V ~55 mA (analog ~40 mA plus U10 ~15 mA), -12 V ~40 mA; the TBA 2 gives 80 mA per rail. Budget at 5 V: XIAO ~30 mA, PS1 ~230 mA, LED 2 mA;

g.text: ~260 mA typical, 330 mA worst case; USB 2.0 allows 500 mA. PS1 is the only power path across the ground barrier: its 1.5 kV isolation is what floats the audio side.

g.desc: ~260 mA typical, 330 mA worst case; USB 2.0 allows 500 mA. PS1 is the only power path across the ground barrier: its 1.5 kV isolation is what floats the audio side.

g.text: Audio grounds meet once at PS1 Common. Keep PS1 at the far end of the board from J1 / J2. Total rail capacitance stays under the 220 uF the TBA 2 allows.

g.desc: Audio grounds meet once at PS1 Common. Keep PS1 at the far end of the board from J1 / J2. Total rail capacitance stays under the 220 uF the TBA 2 allows.
